request.style: English, female solo voice with warm choir, piano, strings, acoustic guitar, soft percussion, intimate and hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I am always with you held by your hand
Guided by counsel toward the promised land
In the heaven above I have no one else
On the earth below you are my wealth

[Chorus]
My flesh and my heart may fail
But God is the rock of my heart
My portion forever remains
The strength within my frail

[Verse]
Those who are far from you will perish
Destroying all who are unfaithful
But as for me it is good to be near
Refuge in the Lord I find

[Chorus]
My flesh and my heart may fail
But God is the rock of my heart
My portion forever remains
The strength within my frail

[Bridge]
I tell of all your works with joy
Near God my spirit finds its home
No fear remains when I am close
Your light upon the world is shown

[Chorus]
My flesh and my heart may fail
But God is the rock of my heart
My portion forever remains
The strength within my frail

[Outro]
God is my portion forever
My rock and my strength
